status: Views 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.6 are Kyle-locked in R10. 1.4/1.5 (the hallmark) are marked OPEN in the R10 catalog itself, awaiting Kyle's nod on the branch-height number -- exported here as production-ready drafts for his review, not shipped as final.

fonts.wordmark_headline: Fraunces, opsz 14, wght 640 (class .frk) -- used in 1.1 stacked + 1.2 horizontal KLJ
fonts.wordmark_tile: Fraunces, opsz 14, wght 720 (class .frkt) -- used in 1.3 tile KLJ
fonts.wordmark_sub: Geist Mono, wght 500 (class .gm) -- used for VENTURES in 1.1 + 1.2

colophon_copy.rule: Verbatim, never reworded. Host product's smallest caption style + muted token, paired with the 1.5 colophon-cut hallmark in the same ink. Once per surface. Product-voice prefix allowed. Plain text until kljventures.com exists -- never links to the career domain.

hallmark_usage.standard_cut: klj-hallmark-standard.svg -- 24px and up, stroke-width 2, frame stroke 0.6
hallmark_usage.colophon_cut: klj-hallmark-colophon.svg -- 12-24px rendered size, stroke-width 2.3, frame stroke 1.1
hallmark_usage.color_rule: currentColor (parameterized). Gold (#f5c451 dark / #e0a92e light) on founder surfaces. Each app's own muted-ink token elsewhere -- never gold, never a hero accent color, inside a product.

production_notes: All wordmark text (1.1, 1.2, 1.3) is outlined to real SVG paths (Fraunces + Geist Mono variable-font instances extracted with fontTools) -- these files carry no font dependency and render correctly wherever they're dropped, including contexts that can't load a host page's web fonts.
1.1's textLength=300/lengthAdjust=spacing behavior is reproduced via computed even per-glyph tracking rather than relying on live SVG textLength (which only works on live <text>, not outlined paths).

1.2's divider rule x-position and 1.3's underline rule x/width were computed from each outlined glyph run's real ink bounding box, matching the R10 catalog's own runtime getBBox-driven placement rather than its static HTML fallback values.

The hallmark SVGs ship as pure geometry (no text), fully spec-exact, with fill/stroke set to currentColor so the same file works as a reusable component across every surface -- just set `color` on the element or an ancestor.
